title: LeChef reviewed swap (app-facing, derived from a PR #114 pair)
description: What SubstitutionTable.options(ingredientID:role:) returns. Source data is PR #114's data/substitutions/pairs.json (schema 1.1.0, 279 pairs, 381-ingredient registry, 11 roles, 13 restrictions), shipped in the bundle as-is; this is the derived shape LeChef consumes, referenced by pairId. Recheck is fail-closed via facts_key exact-name match (null -> unknown -> ask-the-user).

pairId.description: stable snake_case id from pairs.json, e.g. butter-fat-to-olive-oil

originalId.description: the app's Int64 ingredients.id, mapped via facts_key exact-name match

basis.description: volume | mass | count, per the pair's ratio.basis

difference.description: the pair's one-sentence difference. Never promises 'no change'.

verdict.description: ContextRules.verdict over the pair's evidence; unknown is never upgraded to fit

allergenClasses.description: the substitute's allergen closure incl. compound paths; wheat rides on gluten

compositionKnown.description: false (null facts_key) fails closed: ask-the-user for reviewed swaps, blocked for live

restrictionNote.description: conditional-fails restriction wording when one applies at the table
